manifest.name: @local/dsh-super-ptc-mode
manifest.description: Configuration-only DSH profile bundle that adds the super-ptc agent preset: PTC tool presentation plus an aggressive Agent Teams delegation doctrine.

bundle.text:
# @local/dsh-super-ptc-mode — profile bundle patch.
#
# Inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration: the shipped `ptc`
# preset composition (PTC presentation: only `run_code` is called directly,
# every other tool is a generated-SDK binding) plus a preset-scoped persona
# suffix that carries the SUPER PTC delegation doctrine.
#
# The persona suffix is the only behavioural addition: it shadows the
# deployment persona suffix for sessions of this preset alone, because it is
# mounted inside the preset composition. The Agent Teams tool surface
# (spawn_teammate, send_message, list_agents, wait_agent, interrupt_agent and
# the team_task_* board) is provided by the host profile's
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` bundle; this preset
# depends on that bundle being enabled.
#
# Profile layer order note: this bundle patch is applied before the profile's
# own cordis.patch.yml, so the profile may still override the preset row by id
# (`preset-super-ptc`) if an operator edits it from the Web editor.

- insert:
    - id: preset-super-ptc
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: super-ptc
        order: 5
        name: 超级 PTC 模式
        description: PTC 呈现 + 超级委派策略：默认先拆分独立工作流，组建 Agent Teams，维护共享任务板，并对队友产物做验证后再收尾。
        plugins:
          # ── identity: PTC persona plus the SUPER PTC delegation doctrine ──
          # The suffix renders as `deployment:persona-suffix` (first-party
          # order 10200), i.e. after the PTC SDK instructions and tool
          # guidance: the doctrine has the last word. It must stay free of
          # `{{…}}` prompt-variable syntax because persona text is a strict
          # template.
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
              suffix: |
                Apply these rules only when your runtime context says you are the Team Lead. If it names you a teammate, or names no Team role, this delegation doctrine does not apply to you: do your assigned work directly, stay inside your write scope when you have one, verify what you report, and report honestly.

                As the Lead, treat delegation as the default path to a correct, fast result. On every request decide how to split, staff, monitor, and verify the work; small requests still get that decision; only non-trivial work gets a team. You call only run_code directly; every other tool is a binding inside a program.

                Before substantial execution, identify the independent workstreams and delegate each one whose parallel execution is likely to improve speed or quality. Start by decomposing, not by editing files yourself. Do not ask the user for permission to use teammates. If you keep a workstream, justify that by a dependency on other work, contention over shared state, or delegation overhead that exceeds the benefit; never by your own ability to finish it faster. Keep the smallest effective team, typically one to four bounded teammates. Spawn only when it shortens the critical path or raises confidence, never as activity or a relay layer. Teammates report to you and do not spawn further.

                Create shared tasks before you spawn teammates. Each task states the deliverable, acceptance criteria, owner, dependencies, and write scope; its brief must be self-contained because a fresh teammate does not see your conversation. Before spawning, confirm that the brief and board answer: what proves the work is done; which paths the owner may write and which must stay untouched; what the work depends on and who owns that; what the owner must return. Order dependent work with blockers, and split writes so no two members write the same file, directory, build output, log, or other shared mutable state concurrently. Write scopes are a planning contract, not a lock. Use the legacy subagent tools only for one-shot work that needs no ownership, steering, or shared tracking.

                PTC changes the mechanics, not the strategy. One program can spawn several teammates and create their tasks; one program can read the roster, the task board, and several artifacts in parallel. Independent read-only calls may overlap, mutating calls do not, and writes from separate programs still race. Only printed or returned output reaches you; print a compact digest (target, task id, status, one-line result) and keep raw payloads out of the conversation. Decisions, verified evidence, and final results belong there; the traffic that produced them does not.

                While teammates run, do the Lead work they cannot: set interfaces and architecture, resolve dependencies, unblock the critical path, prepare integration, and review incoming work as it arrives. Do not duplicate a task another member owns; independently verifying a high-risk change is a separate, legitimate task, but a second investigation of the same question is waste. Treat delegation as continuous management: after each wait_agent, read the roster with list_agents and the board again; steer with send_message; interrupt a stuck or off-brief teammate with interrupt_agent; when a member is blocked, failed, or abandoned, unblock, reassign, or take it over deliberately and tell the team what changed. Take over delegated work only for those reasons or when a cross-cutting decision is yours alone. Do not answer while a required teammate is still running unless you deliberately stop it.

                A teammate's completion message is a claim, not evidence. Verify every deliverable against its acceptance criteria by reading the artifact and running the relevant checks; review the final diff and run the tests before you integrate. Mark a task complete only after that verification, and never let an inactive teammate, a full task board, or a long report stand in for a verified result. Resolve integration conflicts yourself rather than handing them back. Optimize verified completion per unit of time and cost, not teammate count or message volume; stop any teammate that no longer shortens the critical path or raises confidence. In your final answer, report the team's true state: what is verified, what is partial, what failed, and what remains unresolved.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # ── shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          # ── filesystem ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # ── background jobs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          # ── skills ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          # ── goals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          # ── plan mode ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          # ── compaction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          # ── delegation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          # The Agent Teams tools are host-scoped (experimental bundle) and are
          # therefore present in this preset's catalog without a row here. The
          # legacy subagent tools stay mounted exactly as in the shipped ptc
          # preset for one-shot work, while the doctrine makes Team delegation
          # the default strategy.
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
                disabled: true
          # ── remaining model-facing rows ────────────────────────────────────
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          # ── presentation: PTC mode for this agent alone ────────────────────
          - id: tool-presentation
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
            config:
              mode: ptc
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

readme.section: Super PTC Mode · 超级 PTC 模式
readme.text:
`@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode` is a configuration-only DSH profile bundle. Installing it adds one agent preset, **Super PTC Mode** (id `super-ptc`): the shipped **ptc** composition — PTC tool presentation — plus a preset-scoped persona suffix that carries the **SUPER PTC** Agent Teams delegation doctrine.

Repository: <https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode>

readme.section: Super PTC Mode · 超级 PTC 模式
readme.text:
本包是纯配置的 DSH Profile Bundle：安装后新增 Agent 预设「超级 PTC 模式」（id `super-ptc`）。它保留 PTC 呈现——模型只直接调用 `run_code`，其余工具在程序内以生成 SDK 的形式调用——并在预设作用域内追加「超级委派」系统提示，要求 Lead 先拆分独立工作流、建立共享任务、派生有界队友，验证产物后再收尾。

*The DSH new-session preset picker lists 超级 PTC 模式 alongside the shipped modes (标准模式 / PTC 模式 / 极简模式 / 创造模式).*

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Package | `@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode` |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Repository | <https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode> |
| Preset id | `super-ptc` |
| Display name | 超级 PTC 模式 (en: Super PTC Mode) |
| Kind | configuration-only: no `index.js`, no build step, no runtime dependencies |
| Patch | `cordis.patch.yml` (declared as `dsh.bundle.patch`) inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, `preset-super-ptc` |
| License | MIT |

The only behaviour this bundle ships is that preset declaration. There is no host plugin code and no client code. The `@local/` scope and `private: true` are intentional: this is a local profile bundle installed from a checkout, not a package published to npm.

The preset mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` with `mode: ptc`. For agents joined to this preset the tool catalog collapses to the `run_code` transport plus a generated SDK: every other tool is reachable only from inside a `run_code` program as `await tools.<name>(args)`. Independent calls can therefore be batched in one program, which cuts round trips and keeps intermediate output out of the conversation.
The preset restates the shipped `ptc` composition so that PTC, delegation, and the doctrine stay one coherent preset:
`plugin_manager` and plugin-market tools are disabled inside sessions of this preset, so the agent cannot reconfigure its own profile from a delegated session.

The delta against the shipped `ptc` preset is the persona suffix. It is mounted inside the preset composition, so it shadows the deployment persona suffix for sessions of this preset only; other presets and existing chats are unaffected. It renders after the PTC SDK instructions and tool guidance, so the doctrine has the last word on how work is executed. The text must stay free of `{{…}}` prompt-variable syntax because persona text is a strict template.

In short, the doctrine tells the Lead to decompose non-trivial work before acting, create shared tasks with acceptance criteria and disjoint write scopes before spawning, keep teammates bounded (typically 1–4) with self-contained briefs, own integration and final verification, and never equate a completion message with verified success.

Agent Teams tools are **not** declared by this bundle. They come from the host profile's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` bundle: `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agents`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board `team_task_create` / `list` / `get` / `update`.

| Requirement | Why |
|---|---|
| DSH desktop or web **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer | Verified on 0.2.1-rc.5; the bundle uses the same composition surface the shipped `ptc` preset uses. |
| Agent Teams experimental bundle enabled (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`) | Supplies `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agents`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board. Without it the preset still mounts, but the team tools are absent and the doctrine is unactionable. |
| A composed PTC runtime (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node`; included in the desktop app) | A `ptc` presentation without a PTC runtime is refused at mount time, naming the failing row. |

1. Clone the repository and keep the checkout in place (a local-directory install links it; `files` does not filter a linked directory):

```bash
   git clone https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode.git
   ```

2. In DSH, install the bundle from the cloned directory with the `plugin_manager` tool:

```
   plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <absolute path to the cloned dsh-super-ptc-mode directory>
   ```

Do not hand-edit the profile's dependency list or patch to install it.

3. If the install result reports `restart-required`, restart DSH before using the preset.

4. Select **Super PTC Mode** (id `super-ptc`) as the preset for a new session. Existing chats keep their own preset.

5. Verify in the new session: the roster and bundle details show the title and icon; the system prompt contains the doctrine; only `run_code` is directly callable and the generated SDK exposes the team tools. See [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the checked acceptance criteria and a reproduction outline.

The bundle patch is applied before the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, so a profile-level override of the row id `preset-super-ptc` wins if an operator edits it.

Tested on the DSH desktop app **0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows**. The composition is platform-neutral where the shipped `ptc` preset is: it mounts `pwsh` on Windows and `bash` elsewhere, and the rest of the rows are ordinary DSH plugins. UI titles and descriptions follow the DSH locale (`en` / `zh`).

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Manifest; `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml`; exports `./locale/*.json`, `./icon`, `./cordis.patch.yml` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The preset declaration — the composition this bundle exists for |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | `meta.title` + `meta.description`, read by Plugin Manager and Settings without activating a plugin |
| `icon.svg` | Original artwork, square `0 0 64 64`: a dark tile, three connected team nodes with the Lead node in the centre, and a lightning bolt for PTC speed. No external references, fonts, or embedded raster; ~1 KB |
| `screenshots/preset-picker.png` | The DSH preset picker showing 超级 PTC 模式 next to the shipped modes |
| `docs/VERIFICATION.md` | Public verification summary: acceptance table, evidence statements, reproduce outline |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

The bundle was verified end to end on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: the preset appears in the roster, a real session mounts it, the persisted system prompt contains the doctrine verbatim, the request header exposes only `run_code`, the generated SDK declares all nine Agent Teams bindings, and a real teammate plus shared-task flow completed. Details, per-criterion results, and how to reproduce them are in [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md).
Disable or remove the bundle in DSH plugin management (`plugin_manager` `set_bundle` / `remove_bundle`); the preset row disappears with it. Removing it does not touch the Agent Teams bundle.
[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 zouyuanqing

- **组成**：一个 Agent 预设「超级 PTC 模式」（id `super-ptc`）。工具呈现为 PTC：只直接暴露 `run_code`，其余工具由生成的 SDK 在程序内调用；agent 复刻官方 `ptc` 预设的工具行，并额外注入预设作用域内的「超级委派」系统提示。
- **依赖**：需要宿主 Profile 启用 Agent Teams 包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`（提供 `spawn_teammate`、`send_message`、`list_agents`、`wait_agent`、`interrupt_agent` 和共享任务板）；还需要 PTC 运行时（桌面版自带）。需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。
- **安装**：`git clone` 本仓库后，在 DSH 中用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向克隆目录；按结果刷新或重启，然后在新会话中选择「超级 PTC 模式」预设。本地目录安装会链接该检出目录，请保留它。
- **验证**：验收标准、逐项证据与复现步骤见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。
- **许可**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
- **文件**：`cordis.patch.yml` 是唯一的组合声明；`locale/*.json` 与 `icon.svg` 提供插件管理与设置页的标题、描述和图标；本 README 与 `docs/VERIFICATION.md` 仅作文档。
